title: eval on-demand job payload

variants.description: One EvaluationRuns row per variant, run against the same index; the P1a three-way gold-set run lists all three.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of an eval job of kind on-demand (processing design §13.4-§13.6): the collection's evaluation set, once per variant, over its live sets. Dedup eval:{collectionId}.
